mapper.select: SELECT * FROM book WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM book WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY publish_date DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET sales = sales + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{bookId}
UPDATE book SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{bookId} AND stock >= #{quantity}
mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(b.id) AS bookCount, COALESCE(SUM(b.sales), 0) AS totalSales FROM category c LEFT JOIN book b ON c.id = b.category_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort ORDER BY c.sort
